hypotheses.justification: This follows from D. Each c k is a closed immersion, hence locally of finite type; awayι₀ is an open immersion, and ProjSpace.π is proper, hence locally of finite type. Composition and D.hover give LocallyOfFiniteType ((D.U k).ι ≫ f). Apply IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_iSup_eq_top with D.hcov. Install the recovered instance and use the original proof. This argument also handles an empty cover and trivial rings.

Each D.U k is affine: D.c k is a closed immersion into an affine scheme, so use isAffine_of_isAffineHom. Thus each U k is compact. The finite cover D.hcov and isCompact_iUnion imply CompactSpace X. Since Spec A is quasi-separated, quasiCompact_of_compactSpace recovers QuasiCompact f, after which the original proof applies. Finite-union compactness includes the empty-cover case, and no nontriviality of A is required.
